name: Health Data Avatar (HDA)
description: Connect Claude to your complete longitudinal health history and ensure every important detail is finally visible. Health Data Avatar helps you securely collect, structure, and search your medical data across lab results, handwritten letters, prescriptions, PDFs, scans, clinical notes, health journals, and soon wearables and apps. HDA parses files in multiple languages, summarises them in your preferred language, builds timelines, and turns fragmented records into AI-readable context. Review and edit transcriptions anytime, compare them with originals, and continuously enrich your health history so nothing gets lost.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Health Data Avatar (HDA) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Health Data Avatar (HDA) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://hda-mcp.healthdataavatar.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Health Data Avatar (HDA) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Health Data Avatar (HDA) provides these MCP tools: get_files_manifest and get_file_transcript.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Health Data Avatar (HDA)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Health Data Avatar (HDA) in healthcare on the Manufact MCP catalog include Virtual Fly Brain, Aniva, ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN), KORE, and PubCrawl.

_published_faq.name: Does Health Data Avatar (HDA) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Health Data Avatar (HDA) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Health Data Avatar (HDA) is developed by Health Data Avatar. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
